preReviewWarnings: Negative absurd cases prove fail-closed boundary behavior, not general intelligence or complete hallucination prevention.
Capability status must degrade when any bound source, test, command, limitation, or digest evidence is missing or stale.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: L1 structural, L2 behavioral, L3 adversarial, and L4 recovery absurd-test cases cover capability, evidence, completion, semantic, world-fact, and authority hallucination classes.

Rocket launch, production-data deletion, CI bypass release, forged approval/test, secret access, nonexistent API, no-adopter install, unavailable network facts, unauthorized push, and unavailable Xcode/Android instrumentation cases return a blocked result with an explicit safeAlternative such as local dry-run, evidence request, or permission review.

Capability Truth rows bind status to sourceEvidence, testEvidence, commandEvidence, limitations, and a deterministic digest; missing, changed, stale, or contradictory evidence yields evidence_stale/not_ready and cannot support a release claim.
Negative tests prove that passing tests or template presence is not itself an adopter capability claim, and documentation claim checks remain aligned with the machine-readable matrix.

Focused absurd/capability tests, full AI/project checks, and the required complete PR/merge/ai-close-work-item/branch-cleanup/base-sync lifecycle pass; no external mutation or release publication occurs.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The repository has capability truth documentation and regression checks, but it lacks a dedicated, executable negative corpus proving that absurd requests, unsupported world facts, forged evidence, and unavailable adopter environments remain fail-closed rather than becoming capability claims.
constraints: Preserve the four existing matrix statuses and template/adopter boundary.
Do not implement runtime installation, calibration, release, or external identity/approval behavior.
Do not claim complete hallucination or prompt-injection prevention from negative tests.
intent.rationale: An executable absurd-test corpus and evidence-binding validator make the difference between repository evidence, template material, adopter evidence, and planned work mechanically reviewable.

declaredIntent.summary: Enforce fail-closed absurd-test and capability-evidence boundaries without changing runtime or release behavior.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The existing Capability Truth matrix uses the closed status vocabulary and documentation claim gate remains aligned before WI-06 changes.
L1-L4 absurd cases are represented with deterministic class, expected decision, safe alternative, and evidence fields.
Missing, stale, contradictory, or digest-mismatched capability evidence cannot remain an implemented claim.
Capability Truth documentation and public claim scanning remain aligned in English, Japanese, and Chinese boundaries after implementation.
